messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU prefill OOM spike on inference-prod-east-2 (node inf-12). Containers restarting, error rate increasing. Pager triggered.
maria_nguyen: seeing repeated container restarts on model route /v1/generate/gptx-2048. Logs show 'CUDA out of memory' during prefill for long-context requests.
samir_patel: confirmed. We have a few noisy long-context requests causing KV cache blowout. Trying immediate mitigation: reduce prefill batch size and enable aggressive KV eviction on the pool.
jake: applying hotpatch to gpu-pool-2 now — setting PREFILL_BATCH=1 and PREFILL_KVCACHE_MAX_ITEMS=200000. Command:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/gpu-inference-pool-2
kubectl set env deploy/gpu-inference-pool-2 PREFILL_BATCH=1 PREFILL_KVCACHE_MAX_ITEMS=200000
```
marta_support: support has reported increased 500s for customer AcmeCorp; they're seeing degraded responses on long prompts. I've DM'd Acme contact and posted a public incident note.
samir_patel: added a live fallback policy to route >60k-token prefill to cpu-fallback model variant to avoid OOMs. This will increase latency but keeps requests alive.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: prefill-oom -> reduce batch, enable eviction, enable fallback. Link: https://redwood.runbooks/prefill-oom
maria_nguyen: monitoring metrics — OOM restarts dropping after patch, 95th latency climbing but errors decreasing. Visual: https://grafana.redwood/shot/abc123
jake: note: this patch reduces throughput on that pool; autoscaler will add nodes if needed. Keep an eye on quota.
marta_support: customer update sent: "We're mitigating OOMs by temporarily routing very large prompts to a fallback path to preserve availability. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline." :white_check_mark:
samir_patel: prepping postmortem notes. Key actions: hotpatch batch, enable kv eviction, enable cpu fallback, contact customer.
maria_nguyen: handing off to night oncall @marta_support for monitoring and customer follow-ups. Please escalate if errors >3% in next 30m.
marta_support: ACK. Handoff summary posted to #incidents with links. :thumbsup:
